disclaimer: By connecting to play.wolfmc.fun or joining our Discord, you agree to adhere to all the rules listed below. Ignorance of rules is not an excuse.

rules.title: Respectful Behavior
rules.description: Harassment, racism, hate speech, toxicity, and excessive toxicity are strictly forbidden across both Minecraft chat and Discord.

rules.title: No Spam or Advertising
rules.description: Do not spam chat, advertise other Minecraft servers, social media handles without permission, or post phishing links.

rules.title: Doxxing & Real-Life Threats
rules.description: Sharing personal information (doxxing), IP addresses, or making real-life harm threats will result in an immediate permanent network ban.

rules.title: Unfair Advantages & Hack Clients
rules.description: Using hacked clients (Killaura, Fly, Speed, Jesus, Reach), illegal mods, X-Ray texture packs, or automated bots (Baritone) is strictly prohibited.

rules.title: Hardware & Autoclickers
rules.description: Autoclickers, macros, hardware debouncing adjustments, or software that generates clicks above the CPS limit are not permitted.

rules.title: Bug & Exploit Abuse
rules.description: Abusing server dupes, glitches, unpatched game bugs, or bypassing arena barriers must be reported immediately to staff. Exploiting will result in inventory wipes and bans.

rules.title: Combat Logging
rules.description: Disconnecting or intentionally crashing during active combat to avoid heart loss is strictly prevented by CombatTag. Any evasion glitching is punishable.

rules.title: Heart Farming & Alt Accounts
rules.description: Killing alternate accounts or colluding with players repeatedly in designated safe areas to artificially farm hearts is considered boosting.
rules.punishment: All Hearts Reset to Default (10) + 7-Day Ban

rules.title: Trap & Portal Trapping
rules.description: Creating unescapable death portal traps at public world spawn portals or teleportation spawn points is strictly forbidden.

rules.title: Spawn Camping & Safe Zone Glitching
rules.description: Attacking players inside safe zones or hitting players through safe-zone boundaries using glitch mechanics is prohibited.

rules.title: Trading & Item Scams
rules.description: Scamming during safe-zone item exchanges or drop-trading is non-refundable. Always use official trade commands or staff-monitored stalls.

rules.title: Queue Dodging & Elo Boosting
rules.description: Win-trading, intentionally throwing ranked matches to boost friends' Elo ratings, or queue dodging repeatedly is strictly tracked.

rules.title: Cross-Teaming in Solo FFA
rules.description: Teaming with other players in solo free-for-all practice arenas is prohibited.

rules.title: Staff Discretion
rules.description: Server staff reserve the right to mute or ban players if behavior actively harms server stability or player experience, even if not explicitly listed.

rules.title: Official Appeals Process
rules.description: To appeal any punishment, open a ticket on our official Discord server at https://discord.gg/PKYFEDhFkb. Arguing with staff in public chat will get appeals denied.
